At the upper end the spout would be ~20 cm above the rim with up to ±2 cm lateral offset, so the stream can splash out of or miss the mug. Narrow the slack one step to moderate so the pour pose stays at the carry standoff; everything else (upright carry rows, the level-lateral-axis pour path with free tipping roll, and the spout-down subgoal orientation) is adequate.
